This closes an evidence-inflation path where correlated overlapping forecasts could masquerade as larger effective sample size or stronger drift evidence.
accepted_findings: Overlap-aware calibration fitting and independent-window OOS drift retirement are verified on current main.
Exact Git-revision and predicted-label conditioning prevent calibration evidence from silently crossing incompatible model revisions or outcome classes.

rejected_findings: Raw forecast count is not effective independent sample size when forecast windows overlap.
A healthy or well-calibrated shadow learner does not validate the underlying market hypothesis or authorize production/execution.
Calibration evidence from one label or code revision must not be generalized to another without separately qualified evidence.
conflicts: Learning/evidence-governance infrastructure remains materially fresher than AION/DAEDALUS substantive specialist evidence.
Improved calibration quality cannot substitute for missing cross-lane market evidence or unresolved source/provider disagreements.
blockers: AION has no newer substantive receipt established beyond its older research handoff; no substantive DAEDALUS commit/event was established in the inspected repository evidence.
Flow remains materially fresher than the other specialist lanes and does not by itself establish a cross-market regime.
Any calibration cohort lacking sufficient independent non-overlapping OOS windows must remain unqualified or retired rather than gaining confidence from correlated sample volume.
